next_question: Can entropy-rate estimation (H(Y|Z,A) vs H(Y|Z) without per-stratum KL weighting) or Bayesian model comparison detect the 1.52-bit CMI signal on the stochastic 12-state SPA while maintaining null centering, thereby bypassing the plug-in KL bias-variance tradeoff?
why_next: The frozen FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict via C3 closes the plug-in KL alpha sweep pathway on the stochastic 12-state SPA: the tradeoff between sensitivity (K3>=0.5) and null centering (|null_mean|<0.1) is monotonic and irreconcilable across alpha in {0, 0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0}. No alpha achieves both. The bias is intrinsic to per-stratum KL weighting across varying-size strata with Laplace smoothing, not a hyperparameter tuning problem. Orthogonal estimators that do not weight per-stratum PMI contributions (entropy-rate, Bayesian model comparison, likelihood-ratio) may bypass this bias-variance tradeoff. Entropy-rate estimation measures H(Y|Z,A)-H(Y|Z) globally rather than summing per-stratum KL, which could avoid the small-stratum bias that dominates at alpha<1.0.

established: Sensitivity-null tradeoff for plug-in KL D_KL(P(Y|Z,A)||P(Y|Z)) with Laplace smoothing is monotonic and irreconcilable on stochastic 12-state SPA at N=5000: alpha=0 K3=1.377 bits but |null_mean|=0.924; alpha=1.0 |null_mean|=0.064 but K3=0.099. No crossover exists. (EXP-PHYSICS-35530591329 result.json:metrics.alpha_sweep_summary, metrics.sensitivity_null_tradeoff)

C1 passers {1.0} and C3 passers {0, 0.01, 0.1} have empty intersection on this SPA class. (EXP-PHYSICS-35530591329 result.json:controls.C1-NULL-CONTROL passing_alphas=[1.0], controls.C3-POSITIVE-CONTROL)
Null centering (C1) is robust at alpha=1.0: |shuffled-action null_mean|=0.064, 1.6x below 0.1 threshold. (EXP-PHYSICS-35530591329 result.json:controls.C1-NULL-CONTROL)

True I(Y;A|Z) on stochastic 12-state SPA is 1.52 bits (audit-confirmed). Plug-in KL alpha=0 recovers K3=1.377, alpha=0.1 recovers K3=0.743, both exceed 0.5 threshold. (EXP-PHYSICS-35510154353 audit.json + EXP-PHYSICS-35530591329 replication)

KSG CMI k=5 is k-invariant on discrete data (sklearn discrete_features=True): identical K3=0.000560 for k=5,10,20. Implementation uses categorical matching, not distance neighborhoods. (EXP-PHYSICS-35510154353 result.json:metrics.ksg_k_invariance)

Plug-in KL alpha=1.0 Laplace smoothing has bias exceeding signal: degenerate control K3=0.109 on deterministic SPA (I=0) > stochastic K3=0.099. 88% pseudo-count mass. (EXP-PHYSICS-35510154353 result.json:metrics.plugin_kl_smoothing_bias)

Design verification passes: 48/48 (state,action) pairs with 4 distinct candidates, 2 non-empty stratum size buckets. (EXP-PHYSICS-35530591329 result.json:controls.C6-DESIGN-VERIFICATION, C7-STRATUM-COVERAGE)

Sparse strata coverage: 26.4% of K2 strata have >=5 records at N=5000 (380/1438), below 30% MEASUREMENT_INVALID threshold. FALSIFIED priority overrides. (audit.json V3-sparse-strata-coverage, recomputed_metrics.decision_rule_recomputed.coverage_K2=0.264)

do_not_assume: This FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict closes C-WEB-DYNAMICS or the Physics lane. It closes only the plug-in KL alpha sweep pathway on this specific SPA class. Alternative estimators and hyperparameters remain untested.
CMI estimation is fundamentally impossible on discrete SPAs. Audit confirms MLE alpha=0 recovers K3=1.377 bits (1.52-bit true CMI). The signal IS detectable; the failure is estimator-class-specific.
The 1.52-bit true CMI is undetectable. Per-stratum PMI 1.46-1.69 bits across all 48 strata (p=0.0) and MLE 1.377 bits confirm the signal is strong.
Production Web transitions generalize from this synthetic 12-state SPA. SPA has hash routing, 4 candidates per (state,action), no anti-bot, auth, visual complexity, or production stochasticity.
The within-session shuffle correction changes C1 pass/fail. C1 margin is 1.6-8x below threshold; correction does not affect outcome.

Sparse strata (26.4% coverage below 30% threshold) invalidate the measurement. FALSIFIED priority overrides MEASUREMENT_INVALID in the frozen decision rule. The measurement is valid; the sparse regime explains why MLE null is inflated.
The missing baselines (B-PERMUTATION-TEST, B-PARENT-KSG-K5, B-KSG-CMI-K10) affect the C1/C3 gate. These baselines are supplementary; the primary gate is fully characterized by the alpha sweep.

C1 stratification mismatch (K2 for null, K3 for positive control) changes the verdict. Audit V1 confirms the tradeoff is qualitatively robust; quantitative threshold crossing could differ but no alpha achieves both under either K definition.

recommended_action: Design a new frozen experiment testing entropy-rate estimation H(Y|Z,A)-H(Y|Z) (directly computing conditional entropy difference without per-stratum KL weighting) or Bayesian model comparison (action-dependent vs action-independent transition model via Bayes factor) on the stochastic 12-state SPA at N=5000. These estimators measure fundamentally different quantities than plug-in KL and may bypass the per-stratum bias-variance tradeoff. The frozen experiment must include: (a) the same C1 within-session shuffled-action null framework (500 permutations), (b) the same C3 positive control (K3>=0.5 bits, p<=0.001), (c) the same C6/C7 design verification, and (d) a new positive control calibrated for the estimator's natural scale. If entropy-rate or Bayesian estimation passes C1+C3, proceed to beyond-Markov K3-K2 testing. If all orthogonal estimators also fail, the CMI pathway on discrete 12-state SPAs is exhausted and the Physics lane must pivot to production Web data with continuous state representations.
